adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` (throws on invalid payload), then `symmetricDecrypt(...)` (can throw on bad ciphertext/key), then `JSON.parse(...)` (throws on invalid JSON). There is no surrounding try/catch or use of `safeParse`, so malformed requests can throw out of the handler and result in an unhandled 500 response rather than a controlled 400/4xx error.
